integrity: All-size conclusions are proved by coordinate and counting-profile reconstruction; finite program runs merely corroborate. Priority over specialized earlier poset results is not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: For square grids of side at least four the identification theorem is relative to finite strict partial orders; the explicit nontransitive crossed-matching competitor is C2-equivalent in the unrestricted binary-relation class. No result for three or more chain factors and no optimality of quantifier rank six are asserted.
title: Two-chain grid posets are identified by depth-six counting logic
